senses.gloss: m. (denom. of גִּינָּא; cmp. preced.) dyke for irrigating gardens; also pr. n. Ginnai.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 7a:11">Ḥull. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ נהרא</he> the rivulet Ginnai; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 1:3:11">Y. Dem. I, 22ᵃ</cite> top. Y. Shek. VI, 50ᶜ bot. <he>ג׳ שטף זיקין</he> an overflowing dyke carried off wine bottles.
